title: Zorana's Spawner Mod
description: A simple mod that adds crafting recipes for the Mob Spawner and some Spawn Eggs.
body:
A simple mod that adds creating recipes for the Mob Spawner and several Spawn Eggs!

----
This mod adds a new item, the Spawner Core, that sometimes drops when breaking spawners. You can use the new item, a Nether Star, or Dragon's Breath with Iron Blocks and Chains to make a Mob Spawner. 

You make most Spawn Eggs with an Egg, three Amethyst Shards (for Overworld mobs) or three Quarts Blocks (for Nether mobs), and two items related to the mob (four of one item and one of the other). This should fill up the whole crafting table when making Spawn Eggs.

Some Spawn Eggs can be changed into different ones using one of the dimension specific items and one item related to the mob.

All the Spawn Egg recipes all shapeless so all you need to remember are the items needed.

There's also an additional recipe for creating more Dragon Eggs.

----
**_Currently Craftable Spawn Eggs - All Require 1 Egg:_**

_Overworld - Requires 3 Amethyst Shards and:_

- Chicken: 4 Feathers + 1 Raw Chicken
- Cow: 4 Raw Beef + 1 Leather
- Pig: 4 Potatos + 1 Raw Pork
- Skeleton: 4 Bones + 1 Bow
- Zombie: 4 Rotten Flesh + 1 Poisonous Potato
- Spider: 4 Spider Eyes + 1 String
- Slime: 4 Slime Balls + 1 Sime Cube
- Guardian: 4 Prismarine Shards + 1 Prismarine Crystal

_Changing Overworld - Requires 1 Amethyst Shard and:_

- Cave Spider: 1 Spider Spawn Egg + 1 Fermented Spider Eye

_Nether - Requires 3 Quarts Blocks and:_
- Blaze: 4 Blaze Rods + 1 Lava Bucket
- Magma Cube: 4 Magma Cream + 1 Magma Block

_Changing Nether - Requires 1 Quarts Block and:_

- Wither Skeleton - 1 Skeleton Spawn Egg + 1 Wither Skull
